description: This PHP class 'CellAlignment' maps text alignment properties for spreadsheet cells to internal integer codes used in XLS files. It provides static methods to obtain horizontal, vertical, and wrap text alignment settings based on the PhpSpreadsheet Alignment object.

classes.name: CellAlignment
classes.description: A utility class for converting Alignment object properties into internal codes for XLS cell styling.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Returns an integer code representing the horizontal alignment of a cell, based on the Alignment object's horizontal property.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Returns 1 if text wrapping is enabled for the Alignment, otherwise 0.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Returns an integer code representing the vertical alignment of a cell, based on the Alignment object's vertical property.
